# wallix.bastion.secret

Check out account secrets from a WALLIX Bastion — lookup plugin

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Check out the password (or another secret) of each target account from a WALLIX Bastion, with `GET /api/<version>/targetpasswords/checkout/<target>`.
- The authenticated user ([`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user)) must be granted password retrieval on the account by an authorization; the Bastion answers `NOT_AUTHORIZED` otherwise, also for an administrator.
- Use the [`wallix.bastion.secret`](../modules/secret.md) module to extend or check in a checkout explicitly.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter--terms"></a>**_terms** | `list / elements=str` / required | Account targets, in the Bastion format `<account>@<domain>@<device>`, `<account>@<domain>@<application>` or `<account>@<domain>` for a global domain account. |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`. `v3.12` when not set.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_api_version` |
| <a id="parameter-authorization"></a>**authorization** | `str` | Name of the authorization to use when several give access to the account. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_host` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_password` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API. `443` when not set.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_port` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_timeout` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_token` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_USER`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_user` |
| <a id="parameter-cert-format"></a>**cert_format** | `str` | Format of the returned SSH certificate.<br><br>Choices: `openssh`, `ssh.com` |
| <a id="parameter-checkin"></a>**checkin** | `bool` | Check the account in again right after reading the secret, so it is not left locked for the duration of the checkout policy.<br><br>Default: `false` |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login. `true` when not set.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_csrf_enabled` |
| <a id="parameter-duration"></a>**duration** | `int` | Requested checkout duration in seconds, within the limits of the account's checkout policy. |
| <a id="parameter-field"></a>**field** | `str` | What to return for each target.<br>`all` returns the whole checkout response as a dictionary.<br>The lookup fails when the account has no such secret.<br><br>Choices: `password` (default), `ssh_key`, `ssh_certificate`, `login`, `all` |
| <a id="parameter-key-format"></a>**key_format** | `str` | Format of the returned SSH private key.<br><br>Choices: `openssh`, `pkcs1`, `pkcs8`, `putty` |
| <a id="parameter-key-passphrase"></a>**key_passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase the Bastion encrypts the returned SSH private key with, sent in the `X-Key-Passphrase` header. |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>When not set, the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` is used, then `true`.<br><br>Environment variable: `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS`<br><br>Variable: `wallix_bastion_validate_certs` |

## Notes

- Each lookup call is a checkout. It is recorded in the Bastion audit trail and, when the account's checkout policy locks accounts, locks the account for other users until it is checked in or the checkout expires. Lookups are evaluated every time the expression is templated, also in check mode; store the result with `ansible.builtin.set_fact` to check out only once.
- The lookup runs on the controller and connects to the Bastion from there.
- The returned secrets are marked unsafe, so they are never templated. Set `no_log=true` on tasks that use them.
- The connection environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider and of the modules of this collection.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Use a database password
  ansible.builtin.command: /usr/local/bin/db-maintenance
  environment:
    DB_PASSWORD: "{{ lookup('wallix.bastion.secret', 'dbadmin@local@db-01', checkin=true) }}"
  no_log: true

- name: Get an SSH key in PuTTY format
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ lookup('wallix.bastion.secret', 'deploy@local@srv-linux-01', field='ssh_key', key_format='putty') }}"
    dest: /secure/deploy.ppk
    mode: "0600"
  no_log: true

- name: Get the whole checkout response, with explicit connection options
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    root_checkout: >-
      {{ lookup('wallix.bastion.secret', 'root@local@srv-linux-01', field='all',
                bastion_host='bastion.example.com', bastion_user='automation',
                bastion_token=vault_bastion_api_key) }}
  no_log: true
```

## Return value

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return--raw"></a>**_raw** | `list / elements=raw` | One element per target. The secret selected by [`field`](#parameter-field), or with [`field=all`](#parameter-field) a dictionary with `login`, `password`, `ssh_key`, `ssh_certificate`, `locked`, `checkin_time` and the other fields the Bastion returns. |
